atoms.title: Access logs and monitoring
atoms.objective: Interpret physical access log entries to identify anomalous patterns, after-hours entries, repeated failures, and tailgating gaps, and explain what each pattern signals to a security analyst.

atoms.title: Motion detectors and sensor-based detection
atoms.objective: Explain how PIR, microwave, and dual-technology motion sensors detect intrusions, evaluate sensor placement and sensitivity tradeoffs, and classify a given sensor trigger event as a true detection or a false positive.
